pages.title: Normal and Heavy Attacks
pages.text: Enter combat mode with its keybind. Tap the attack key for a normal weapon attack; hold it to charge a heavy attack. Holding attack and use together guards with a combat weapon.

pages.title: Barrage
pages.text: Quickly double-left-click with a battle-system weapon to start Barrage: ten automatic normal attacks over three seconds. Keep aiming at your target; each strike follows your current direction.$(br2)Strikes use normal weapon, ammunition and Qi rules. Switching weapons, guarding, preparing a spell, losing combat state or becoming unable to act stops the sequence.
